subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 02/10] mountd: handle unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall for NFS exports. It addresses two issues: when is_mountpoint() fails, it defers the request instead of answering 'not exported', and it checks for a junction before denying referrals. The patch splits lookup_nonexport() to share junction lookup between downcalls and factors per-request work into nl_add_export_req(). Deferred requests are retried from cache_process() every RETRY_SEC. The kernel keeps the upcall pending in the meantime.
